title: Elux Firerose 5000 Tutti Fruity 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Tutti Fruity from the Elux Firerose 5000 collection is a sweet and playful blend that captures the essence of a classic ice cream flavour. This nic salt e-liquid brings together a delightful assortment of candied fruits and berries, each contributing their unique sweet and tangy notes. The result is a lively and refreshing taste that’s bursting with variety. Adding to this fruity extravaganza is the smooth and creamy flavour of ice cream, which envelops the fruit and berry notes with a rich and indulgent silkiness. This addition creates a beautiful balance, adding a luxurious depth to the vibrant fruit flavours and making each puff feel like a treat. With a 50VG/50PG blend, Berry Bang ensures a perfectly balanced vape that’s ideal for those who enjoy both intense flavour and satisfying yet discreet cloud production. The Nicotine Salt formulation provides a silky smoothness of the vape and is suitable for use in any MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping device. Discover the delicious world of Elux Firerose 5000 Nic Salt e-liquids. This captivating range is inspired by some of Elux’s most popular disposable vape flavours, offering the same intensity of flavour but with the versatility and convenience that comes from 10ml bottles for use with a wide variety of vape devices.
